name: Silver Ridge Holdings Bhd.
overview: 2026年公司没有发布与业务板块直接相关的合约、扩张或退出公告，主要公告为股份发行、公司名称变更及董事会委员会人事变动。公司名称由 Silver Ridge Holdings Bhd 变更为 Tangerine Holdings Bhd。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any contracts, expansions, or exits directly related to its business segments; the main announcements were share issuances, a change of company name, and changes in board committee memberships. The company name changed from Silver Ridge Holdings Bhd to Tangerine Holdings Bhd.
